title: shortage_check result
description: Answer to: can I build N units of product X right now, and if not, what am I missing? Every quantity is expressed in the unit of measure named alongside it. All figures are a snapshot taken at 'as_of' and go stale as soon as stock moves.

as_of.description: UTC timestamp of the stock snapshot. Treat the answer as invalid once stock has moved.

asked.description: Echo of the resolved request, so the agent can confirm it matched the right product and bill of materials.

bom_type.description: 'phantom' means the bill of materials is a kit and was expanded inline rather than producing a separate order.

verdict.description: can_build: the full requested quantity is covered. partial: some but not all. blocked: nothing can be built, or the request could not be evaluated.

max_buildable.description: Largest quantity of the finished product that current free stock supports, rounded DOWN to the product's unit-of-measure precision. Odoo does not record whether a product is discrete, and it accepts fractional manufacturing orders, so this may legitimately be fractional: 11 components consumed 2 per assembly gives 5.5. A caller that builds whole items should floor it.

limiting_components.description: Product codes of the components that cap max_buildable. Empty when nothing is limiting.

components.description: One entry per component line produced by exploding the bill of materials. Kit (phantom) sub-assemblies are expanded; components that have their own manufacturing bill of materials are listed as components, not expanded.

level.description: Depth in the exploded bill of materials. 1 is a direct component of the requested product.

required_qty.description: Total needed to build the full requested quantity.

required_per_unit.description: Needed per single unit of the finished product.

on_hand_qty.description: Physically present (stock.quant.quantity), including stock already reserved for other work.

reserved_qty.description: Already committed to other transfers or manufacturing orders (stock.quant.reserved_quantity).

available_qty.description: on_hand_qty minus reserved_qty, floored at zero. This is the number that actually decides whether you can build.

shortage_qty.description: How much more is needed beyond available_qty. Zero when the component is covered.

max_buildable_from_this.description: Finished-product quantity this single component's free stock supports.

tracking.description: Whether this component is tracked by lot or serial number. Relevant because a shortage in a tracked component may still block even when totals look sufficient.

is_limiting.description: True when this component is one of those capping max_buildable.

has_own_bom.description: True when this component could itself be manufactured rather than purchased.

locations.description: Where the free stock sits. Useful when the total is sufficient but scattered across warehouses.

notes.description: Plain-language remarks about how this particular answer was reached.

limitations.description: What this answer deliberately does NOT account for. Always populated. Present it to the user rather than hiding it - an agent that omits these turns a snapshot into a promise.

error.description: Set when verdict is 'blocked' for a reason other than stock, for example no bill of materials was found.
